reason: Document B provides concrete concessions that make this difficult change easier to accept—specifically the $150/month commuting stipend and the six-month policy review—while being honest about the lack of further exceptions rather than giving false hope. However, it makes a confusing date error by putting the start date in September 2027 (giving the 2-hour-plus commuters only four months of grace until the end of 2027, rather than until the end of next year), making this only a slight win over Document A.
